basis: Dental hard-tissue destruction from acid-producing dysbiotic biofilm; caries alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: biofilm-mediated tooth demineralization does not by itself establish an infection or immune-mediated disorder.

basis: Deafness and pili torti define this mitochondrial metabolic disorder. Eye abnormalities lack evidence of damage; hypogonadism and intellectual disability occur in 5–29%.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the established mitochondrial respiratory-chain disorder is an inborn metabolic disease, independently of occasional hypogonadism.

basis: Oxidative phosphorylation disorder presenting as mitochondrial myopathy; progressive weakness and diagnostic muscle pathology occur in the single annotated patient.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: myopathy is the defining clinical presentation, supported by progressive weakness, ragged-red fibers and respiratory-chain abnormalities in muscle.

basis: Hereditary anemia attributed to erythrocyte ATPase deficiency; the supplied evidence establishes a red-cell disorder without a distinct metabolic disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: an erythrocyte ATPase defect causing anemia does not alone establish a metabolic disorder warranting this additional axis.

basis: Spondyloepiphyseal skeletal dysplasia. Developmental delay and microcephaly are reported without frequencies or established major diagnostic status.

decisions.neurologic: none: unquantified developmental delay and microcephaly do not establish involvement in at least 30% or a major diagnostic criterion.

basis: Benign blood-vessel neoplasm arising in the subglottic airway; both vascular origin and upper-airway location define the lesion.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: hemangioma arises from blood vessels, explicitly supported by the benign blood-vessel neoplasm ancestor.

basis: Diaphragmatic myopathy occurs in 4/4; respiratory failure in 2/4 reflects muscle dysfunction. Cardiomyopathy is 1/4; isolated brain and lung findings lack reliable prevalence.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure results from diaphragmatic muscle weakness; intrinsic pulmonary disease is not established as common or defining.

basis: Inborn glycoprotein metabolic disorder umbrella; direct neurodevelopmental dysfunction affects most patients (>50%) across major glycosylation/deglycosylation groups.

decisions.neurologic: involved: neurodevelopmental dysfunction affects most patients (>50%) across the major glycosylation and deglycosylation disorders; isolated non-neurologic forms are exceptions.

basis: Lymphocytic and plasma-cell neoplasm umbrella. Lymphoma-specific immune labeling is subtype-dependent; lymphoid lineage alone does not establish an immune mechanism.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: this broader category is not itself lymphoma or an immune-mediated disease; the lymphoma-specific mechanism label is not established for the umbrella.

basis: Sinonasal tumor arising from olfactory neural epithelium; upper-airway location and olfactory neural origin define it. Intracranial extension is not required.

decisions.neurologic: primary: olfactory neural origin and olfactory nerve neoplasm ancestry establish the neurologic axis; smell is explicitly included in this axis.
